# Contributing to ImagePaste

ImagePaste is no longer actively maintained.

The main workflow is moving to [Pasty](https://github.com/thanhph111/blender-pasty), a smaller add-on for _Blender_ 4.2 and newer.

Please do not open new ImagePaste maintenance pull requests unless a maintainer has asked for one. The old codebase has become difficult to keep forward-compatible across _Blender_ API changes and platform clipboard behavior.

New bugs, feature requests, and compatibility work should go to [Pasty issues](https://github.com/thanhph111/blender-pasty/issues).

Thank you to everyone who helped build, test, report, and improve ImagePaste.
